name: caffeine-website
description: Caffeine Engine documentation (Svelte site, TeX/PDF, MCP for agents)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,web -c blue,magenta "DOCS_BASE=/docs npm run dev -w @caffeine/docs-site" "npm run dev -w @caffeine/marketing"
scripts.build: DOCS_BASE=/docs npm run build -w @caffeine/docs-site && npm run build -w @caffeine/marketing && node scripts/assemble-dist.mjs
